ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Tolstoy's «дела» (dela, 'works, tasks') is 'works' in his own thoughts, so that the opening (works that are always finished) and the close (works of love) echo, and 'tasks' in Amiel; «дело души» (delo dushi) is 'the work of the soul'. Rousseau's «дикие» (dikiye, 'savages') is kept without the website draft's gloss 'people called savages', and Spinoza's line keeps its italics.
